answer: A lantern of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
